corrections.reason: In Classical Ge'ez (Luke 24:1), the verb agrees with the feminine plural subject (the women): 'ገይሣ ወሖራ' (they rose early and went). Visually, the right leg of 'ሣ' is slightly longer in the print.
The printed glyph in the page image is 1st-order 'ሀ' (ወፈርሀ, a common printing variant for ወፈርሃ) rather than 4th-order 'ሃ'.
There is no 'የ' printed before 'መግደላዊቱ' in the image; the first glyph after 'እርሳቸውም' is 'መ'.
The printed character in 'ሐሰት' is clearly 'ሰ' (two legs), not 'ሠ' (three legs).
